This is the last deficit deadlift of the cycle. Standing on a plate lengthens the pull, so your hamstrings and glutes work harder from the very bottom. Reps are at their lowest this week, which means this should be your heaviest pulling of the block. Aim to beat what you did in Week 4 on every working set.
"}]
